scenes.narration: You stay awake for three days. Here is what your brain does to you.
Hour twenty-four. Your reactions slow down about as much as if you were over the drink-drive limit.
Hour thirty-six. Microsleeps begin. Your brain switches off for a few seconds, eyes open, and you never notice.
Slower focus, missed details, then mistakes. And you are the last to see them.
Hour seventy-two. Some people see or hear things that are not there.
Then you sleep, and your brain collects the deepest sleep first.
